facts.label: In English
facts.value: Two Dragons Sluice (two openings), north end of 昆明湖's east dyke

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a sluice outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: in use; built 1764 (S1233: 乾隆二十九年（1764年），又修筑昆明湖东堤二龙闸及东堤上的灌溉涵洞)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: west end of today's 二龙闸路 (osm way 1186361582) at the lake's east shore; the street keeps the name

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 北京市方志馆 2020 (S1233, viewed): 东堤上建二龙闸，一方面作为圆明园的供水渠道的控制闸；另一方面也是确保东堤安全的泄水闸; the lake bed 1.5-2.0 m above the land outside the dyke. Snippet lead (not opened): north end of the east dyke, two openings. Absent from 日下旧闻考 j60-110 (helper).
